vectors.oracle: All explicitly controlled pool/fleet/self UIDs are zero-masked and an independent validator still observes/weights every legitimate cohort; residual off-chain beneficial ownership is documented.
Content hash, EIP-712 signer, policy/deployment identity and on-chain root all agree across both public origins and MinIO history; tampered copies fail locally.

Runtime 454 retains v453's explicit true-caller CheckColdkeySwap precheck on payable transfer(bytes32), whose transferAllowDeath dispatch originates from the precompile account after Frontier moves msg.value. The adjacent transferKeepAlive(bytes32,uint256) path dispatches from the true caller through the centralized runtime filter. The Go oracle models those decisions but does not execute FRAME; the source gate authenticates the exact retained implementation and upstream runtime test bytes.

The Go oracle models the exact beta-escrow rejection but does not execute FRAME. The source gate authenticates the v453 stake utility and upstream regression-test bytes, and the concurrent sentinel halts on version or code-hash drift.
Empty, self-loop and indirect-cycle updates reject without state change; an acyclic bounded graph is accepted and traversed within its node cap.

Runtime 454 retains the persisted runtime-452 Registration wire identifier and exact SCALE shape. The release accepts exactly one nonzero Sha256 field and returns an attributed error for ResetBondsFlag, alternate variants, extra fields, truncation, or trailing bytes without panicking.
Failed price-limited operations are atomic and retryable, emissions remain pending rather than dropped, and live spot/moving prices and both reserves stay positive with reviewed margins.
The cabal-only UID is clipped to zero below kappa and affiliation masks still cover every controlled pool/fleet UID.
Commit/reveal remains enabled and the follower model cannot alter minority consensus; commit/reveal runtime state and finalized ordering remain stable.
Below-kappa knifing does not reduce honest consensus weights or produce a cabal incentive gain.
A minority stale vector cannot move the stake-weighted median away from the current honest vector; stale-vector divergence and validator trust are recorded.
Sweeps explicitly identify the protection boundary; the live campaign halts if honest active stake or required validator permits fall below policy.
Non-reentrancy, checks-effects-interactions, exact received-funds accounting and state-machine guards preserve conservation under every reorder/failure point.
Bounded restarts recover from durable/canonical state, no evidence disappears or equivocates, and no unexplained warning/retry/restart burst remains.
Domain, signer, nonce, NO, policy and epoch snapshot are atomic; caps and exact received funds hold under replay/reorder.

The Go decision model checks the intended digest predicate but does not execute FRAME. The source gate authenticates the exact v453 verifier and upstream regression-test bytes, while the continuous testnet sentinel pins spec, transaction, state and runtime code identity.
Only monotonic bounded round advancement mutates state; a far-future round is rejected without moving the watermark, and live commit/reveal progress remains finalized.

UR verification signs explicit canonical encodings rather than Synapse.body_hash. Every identity, nonce, depth, path, timing, egress and coverage mutation changes the signed message and is rejected continuously; evidence artifacts independently retain content hashes and signer domains.
Typed domains, exact integer conversions, mirror authorization and budget ceilings reject cross-domain substitution and 10^9-scale errors.
Patched runtime state migrates or resets exactly as specified; UR bindings require a new generation and effective epoch before use.
Value carries only to the same operator, valid claims settle once, expired claims reject, restart recovery is exact and liabilities remain conserved.

Across current/previous-consensus and sigmoid-steepness sweeps, the early independent evaluator retains more than its 60% stake share, the delayed copier receives less than its 40% stake share, and permit loss clears rather than preserves the accumulated bond.
The live hostile testnet implementation cannot mutate immutable vault/reserve custody; pause stops new risk while finalized claims remain callable.

The live actor records best-minus-finalized lag and the exact SDK expiry predicate continuously. Release CRv4 writes use a directly signed immortal extrinsic with a durable exact nonce, exact-byte replay, runtime identity gate, and canonical finalized receipt, so this SDK-only mortality failure cannot silently lose a release intent.

The live actor continuously alternates absent and wrong fixed-width SEED signatures against each loopback operator. Both fail with HTTP 400 before trail state is created, while signed control trails complete under the claimed validator key.

The v453 Go models check direct and announced filter intersection. Runtime 454's additional model requires the pallet-contracts origin filter to admit exactly Proxy::proxy and SubtensorModule::transfer_stake, requires the user's independent delegation, and rejects sibling stake, utility and unknown calls. The source gate authenticates both exact implementations; the custody actor executes the v454 boundary during control and attack phases while the code-hash sentinel binds deployed Wasm. Upstream v454 has no dedicated ContractCallFilter regression, so release acceptance also requires the live disposable precompile/contract conformance battery. No third-party proxy is touched on shared testnet.
No 5xx, bounded response size/latency/error rate, no restart storm, and happy-path deadlines/reconciliation remain intact.
Deterministic largest-remainder allocation, sorted unique leaves, wallet snapshot and on-chain conservation reproduce the exact root independently.

Non-loopback provider configuration rejects plaintext HTTP/WebSocket endpoints. During the live campaign, tampered copies of real signed ASSIGN/FINAL responses fail canonical Ed25519 verification while the original happy path remains valid; loopback plaintext is allowed only inside the isolated simulator.
Server-selected fresh hops, source-IP attribution, canonical signatures, monotone server time and unique path IDs reject repeats/short circuits.
The exact runtime denies every equivalent privileged call for restricted proxy types; no third-party proxy is touched on shared testnet.
The constant-product ordering model quantifies unshielded loss and proves a bound minimum-output call rejects the hostile ordering; release automation refuses unshielded proxy staking.

The queue-state model begins after the runtime's identity, system-account, rate, affordability and lock-id prechecks and does not emulate FRAME storage transactions. The source gate authenticates the exact v453 queue implementation and upstream test bytes; executing those tests requires the pinned upstream Rust checkout.
Every registration is limit-bounded and postconditioned to the planned hotkey/coldkey; plan or live-state drift invalidates execution.
The emulator backs the sum of all live locks and rejects preferential unpriced owner allocation; live moving/spot price, reserve and eviction sentinels never cross their stop conditions.

Every partial/full exit inventory records principal plus the proportional accrued basket, exact floor remainder, second-call requirement and post-exit claimability. Runtime 454 retains v453 holding isolation and adds five exact boundaries: root-only relationship selection, candidate plus raw Alpha/AlphaV2 work accounting, one-atomic-alpha sale for a positive entitlement floored to zero with payout capped to that entitlement, permanent removal of sub-rao withdrawal shares, and dependent cleanup only after a positive storage-GC completion marker. The custody actor executes all changed decision models during both control and attack phases while the runtime sentinel binds the deployed Wasm. Mainnet automation must claim or prove no hidden basket remains.

Runtime 454 retains the v452 root-cleanliness gate: every nonempty basket, stake, claimable, or claimed destination rejects before mutation; a clean move preserves the claimed watermark and exact future owed amount.

Runtime 454 retains the v452 inverse operation: it removes fully unstaked keys, swap-removes the last entry into each hole, and preserves the forward/reverse dense-index bijection; shared-testnet sentinels observe runtime identity and finalized-block latency without creating global state.
All loops/caps are bounded, largest-remainder totals are exact, deploy/runtime sizes fit limits, and worst-case gas stays below the planned ceiling.
Finalized heads converge within three blocks, common-height hashes agree, archive queries succeed and EVM/native checkpoints match under capped pressure.
Every forced downstream failure restores the byte-exact pre-state, never advances a paid watermark, and never emits a successful value event; the live reserve sentinel remains conserved.
Account sums equal total issuance after explicit burn, old and new reserve totals match exactly, failed injections preserve emissions for retry, and stale flow is never injected as one block.
Migration is bijective and lossless across every field, perpetual locks remain perpetual, aggregate locked mass equals contributor sums, and the old identity has no residual authority or entitlement.
Zero-share and over-fill requests leave byte-exact state; a valid partial fill conserves debit/credit/remaining once and an identical replay is a no-op.

Each endpoint reads spec, transaction and state versions plus the runtime code hash at one explicit finalized hash; the doctor additionally hashes the exact SCALE metadata bytes at that same hash. Any mismatch against the release lock halts before metadata drives storage or call encoding.
Exact-runtime attack regressions remain bounded and non-panicking; the shared-testnet actor performs only capped reads while finalized lag and request p99 remain within policy.

Runtime 454 retains v452's rejection of every foreign frame for signed-dispatch precompiles, permits cryptographic/read-only foreign frames, and all release state-changing precompile paths continue to use an ordinary matching-frame CALL; the continuous runtime sentinel halts on any spec, transaction-version, state-version or code-hash drift.
Shadow/poison routing remains indistinguishable, randomized continuous probes overlap happy traffic, and service quality changes appear in independent operator-specific scores.

The finalized runtime floor equals the public manifest and immutable vault value; sub-floor capture stays on its pool; accepted sub-floor claims accumulate non-expiring coldkey credit; exact-threshold aggregation pays only that coldkey; price/runtime failures preserve credit; and measured source/destination deltas gate every accounting transition.
Keyed prefix claims split exactly across concurrent fleets, generations are effective next epoch, and a client/UID cannot bind to two active identities.
Every changed domain/message component and every replay/expired deadline reverts without partial state.

At a common finalized block, private and public precompiles agree that netuid 521 still has nonzero UID count and spot price while spot and moving price trajectories are retained in campaign evidence; mainnet launch separately requires a nonzero moving price and reviewed pruning margin.
Termination atomically repatriates all alpha and lock mass, removes every derived-coldkey index, and preserves total value before proxy removal.

TAO and alpha reserves remain nonzero and their full campaign minima are retained; the bounded signed-flow model clamps net outflow to zero contribution rather than rewarding it. Mainnet remains no-go until the pinned runtime fixes the open upstream accounting paths or exact-runtime proof shows them unreachable.
Every score/binding is keyed by hotkey, generation, effective epoch and live UID; stale generations never receive weight or payout.

The surviving validator remains live, restarted intent recovery is exact, one common native epoch proves opposing selected-positive/rejected-zero top-200 decisions, a later common epoch proves restoration, and reconciliation contains no ambiguous or duplicate submission.
Real and poison responses retain valid signed shapes and bounded timing/size deltas; poison never changes provider statistics or durable proof history.
One mutation wins, contenders receive bounded busy/idempotent responses, final replay is byte-identical and each assigned hop is counted once.
The source-IP hard bound triggers regardless of VPK rotation; malformed input never causes 5xx or unbounded durable state.
